name: 夏月吻寒枝
overview: World-class racer Ji Hanzhi becomes paralyzed after a devastating crash, forcing him into isolation. When fiery caregiver Xia Chuyue enters his life, she pushes him to heal physically and emotionally. Together, they confront family betrayals, uncover secrets behind his accident, and discover love as Ji Hanzhi learns to race toward a second chance at life.
